svg.title: Intelligence loop and the serving-path boundary
svg.desc: Left: what runs on the live request path: telemetry recording and the AIMD origin concurrency gate, which is active only when configured and in canary or active mode. Right: the observe, detect, evaluate, adapt, explain loop whose components have no production caller and run only in the lab simulator and tests. The legacy PIE stub is never constructed.
svg.text: ON THE SERVING PATH (real gateway)
Request: GET / DELETE, cache lookup, single-flight
(Chapter 4)
OBSERVE (counters + latency)
record_us: raw window (read by /metrics) +
2,688-bucket histogram (written, not read),
CacheCounters, OriginMetrics.
ADAPT: AIMD origin gate (OriginGate)
permit per real origin fetch; RAII release
every N observations (default 100):
p99 over ceiling or errors over 5%: cap x 0.70
else cap + 1 (min and max kept; clamp 256)
Enforced only if PHANTOM_ORIGIN_CAP_MAX set
AND mode is canary or active (100% of fetches)
EXPLAIN (thin): /api/v1/intelligence/status
mode, active candidate, revert count.
/audit is served but nothing writes to the store
LEGACY PIE STUB: src/control/pie.rs
pie: None in main.rs. Threshold rule, fixed
expected_utility = 85.0, no canary, no statistics.
Never constructed in the shipped binary.
Not the intelligence.
LIBRARY AND LAB ONLY (no production caller)
OBSERVE + DETECT: WorkloadPipeline (signals.rs)
request-rate EWMA, Count-Min + Space-Saving heavy hitters,
Zipf alpha, working-set sample, CUSUM burst, hot-key emergence
output: SignalWindow with provenance per field
EVALUATE: shadow policies + decision engine
ShadowEvaluator replays a 1-in-R key sample through two simulated
policies (LRU, SIEVE, S3-FIFO, TinyLFU) and compares hit ratios.
PieDecisionEngine: guardrails then 95% interval; Commit, Rollback,
NoAction, Fault. Canary route_bucket: 1024 buckets, 50 candidate
(5%), 10 holdback (1%)
ADAPT: DefaultPolicyExecutor
apply_policy (eviction, stale window, refresh cap), clamps,
revert_to_safe, check_watchdog (heartbeat stall -> revert, mode Off),
safe_apply_policy (panic -> revert)
EXPLAIN: AuditStore + DecisionRecord
100-record ring; nothing in src/ appends to it
Where it runs: unit and integration tests; the lab simulator
(SIMULATED) uses only executor, AIMD, stale controller, admission filter
M6 sealed: H1 NOT_SUPPORTED; tuned optimum was a static cap
Shadow, engine, signals, canary route: tests only
BOUNDARY: no wire between the two sides
Source: main.rs (intel_executor, pie: None), server.rs (acquire_origin_permit, intelligence_*_handler), intelligence/*.rs, grep for callers.
